extracted.intended_audience: Applicants for NIH PHS 398 Career Development Award (K awards); grant writers and institutional grants administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Assembling and submitting a PHS 398 Career Development Award supplemental application (PA-16-190), including required attachments (candidate info, research strategy, mentoring plans, human subjects, budget justification, current & pending support, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Subjects Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the project is a Clinical Trial (Yes/No) and whether it is an Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark the boxes appropriately (example shows Clinical Trial? No). Provide human subjects protections documentation elsewhere (Protection of Human Subjects section).

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Vertebrate Animals Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used and whether animals are euthanized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If animals are euthanized, state whether the method is consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines. If not consistent, describe the method and provide a scientific justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Program Income Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether program income is anticipated during the periods for which grant support is requested (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', use the specified format to reflect anticipated amounts and source(s) by budget period; if 'No', leave section blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', list registration number(s) of specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry; or, if a specific line cannot be referenced, check the box indicating that one from the registry will be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Inventions and Patents Section
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether there are inventions and patents (Yes/No) and whether they were previously reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', answer follow-up questions about prior reporting per the form's instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Change of Investigator / Change of Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Report any change of Project Director/Principal Investigator or change of grantee institution, including name of former PD/PI and former institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the provided fields on the form when such changes have occurred.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Career Development Award — Required Application Components (table of attachments)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Career Development Award supplemental form requires a set list of components/attachments (Introduction; Candidate Info & Goals; Specific Aims; Research Strategy; Progress Report Publication List for renewals; Training in RCR; Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring; Plans and Statements of Mentor/Co‑Mentor(s); Letters of Support; Institutional Environment; Institutional Commitment; Protection of Human Subjects; Data Safety Monitoring Plan; Inclusion of Women and Minorities; Inclusion of Children; Vertebrate Animals; Select Agent Research; Consortium/Contractual Arrangements; Resource Sharing; Authentication of Key Biological/Chemical Resources; Appendix).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include each listed attachment in the order and format specified by the PHS 398 Career Development instructions (file names shown, e.g., M-23_PHS_Career_IntroductionToApplication.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan Section — Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the Specific Aims for the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow standard NIH guidance for concise, testable aims that align with the Research Strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan Section — Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a detailed Research Strategy describing significance, innovation, and approach for proposed studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address major concerns from prior review (if resubmission) and denote revisions; align methods, analyses and aims; include required elements per PHS 398.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the candidate's background, career objectives, and specific plans for career development during the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spell out coursework, formal and informal training, and how these activities will prepare the candidate to achieve research/career goals (example: list of 4 planned courses and short courses/workshops).

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide plans for training the candidate in responsible conduct of research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include format, content, duration, and frequency of RCR training as required by NIH.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe how the candidate will be mentored, including structure and responsibilities for mentoring activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify frequency of meetings, mentoring committee composition, and mentoring activities (e.g., weekly meetings, semi‑annual mentoring committee meetings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentor and Co-Mentor Plans and Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide plans and statements from mentors and co-mentors describing their roles and commitments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentor statements should detail frequency of interaction, specific mentoring responsibilities, availability to review abstracts/manuscripts/grants, and any salary support or lack thereof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors, and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Include letters of support describing institutional/collaborator commitments and planned contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide letters that document access to data/resources, collaborations, and specific roles; use the provided attachment slot(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of Institutional Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the institutional environment where the candidate will conduct training and research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show evidence of adequate facilities, research community, and institutional programs that support the candidate's development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Document the institution's commitment to the candidate's career development (protected time, resources, career support).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include letters or statements describing protected effort, access to cores, and administrative support for the candidate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed plans to protect human subjects involved in the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address risks, protections, inclusion criteria, consent, and compliance with federal human subjects regulations; link to Human Subjects cover page entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Safety Monitoring Plan (DSMP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a Data Safety Monitoring Plan when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe monitoring procedures, oversight committees, frequency of review, and plans for ensuring data integrity and participant safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Address plans and justification for inclusion of women and minority groups in human subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide enrollment plans, analyses by sex/gender and race/ethnicity where appropriate, and justification if exclusion/limited inclusion is proposed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children
rubrics_metrics.description: Address whether children are included in the study and provide justification or exclusion criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIH policies on inclusion of children; describe recruitment and protections for pediatric participants or rationale for exclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose whether research involves select agents and provide required documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Select Agent Research attachment when relevant and follow NIH guidance for oversight and biosafety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium / Contractual Arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any consortium or contractual relationships and include required agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide plans for data sharing, roles of consortium partners, budgets, and letters of collaboration as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide plans for sharing data, model organisms, and other resources generated by the research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Resource Sharing Plan attachment (M-18_PHS_Career_Resource_Sharing_Plan.pdf) and follow NIH expectations for accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe how key biological or chemical resources will be authenticated to ensure reproducibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the Authentication attachment (M-16_PHS_Career_Auth_KeyBioChem_Resources.pdf) per form instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide permitted appendix materials according to PHS 398 rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Appendix attachment slot (M-12_PHS_Career_Appendix.pdf) and include only materials allowed under NIH appendix policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List (for renewals)
rubrics_metrics.description: For renewal applications, include a publication list documenting progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a Progress Report Publication List when submitting a renewal (RENEWAL applications only).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Personnel and Effort
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify personnel roles, percent effort (calendar months), and salary support for the candidate and staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the candidate's PI role and percent effort, list mentors and advisors (noting if no salary support requested), and specify how personnel effort maps to aims/tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Educational Expenses and Coursework
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify tuition, textbooks, and fees for formal coursework and short courses required for career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List planned courses by semester (example: PUBH 5520, PUBH 5538, BIOS 8398, PUBH 5525), note discounts or institutional rates, and provide estimates for registration and travel for short courses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Data Management, Computing, and Biostatistical Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Request funding for data validation, data management, computing support, and biostatistics collaboration center (BCC) services as needed for aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe roles (data manager, data administrator, data abstractor), estimate percent effort or billable hours, reference institutional cores (e.g., ACCRE, BCC), and include rates and basis for calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — BCC Rates and Scientific Resource Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain that biostatistics staff and faculty effort is billed to projects as percent effort, and that an additional scientific resource fee is charged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document that BCC rates reflect complete costs (salaries, admin, computing, compliance), are reviewed annually for non‑profit cost recovery, are adjusted annually, and will be billed monthly via institutional systems (CORES). Provide example fee calculations per FTE where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Travel Expenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Request funds for travel to scientific meetings and workshops (e.g., 2–3 meetings/year, short courses/workshops on methodology).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State plans to submit abstracts to specific meetings (CROI, NHPC, SMDM or SER), budget for flights/hotels, and for attendance at collaborative network meetings (NA‑ACCORD, CCASAnet).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Equipment and Software
rubrics_metrics.description: Request funds for computers (laptop, desktop), software (Adobe, ArcGIS, SAS/Stata, MS Office, Stat Transfer, reference manager), and justify need.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain reasons for hardware replacement/upgrading (processing power, large datasets, simulation), specify timing (e.g., laptop year 1, desktop year 4), and note printer request for collaborator reports and conference handouts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — Publication Costs and Office Supplies
rubrics_metrics.description: Request funds for publication costs and office supplies for the final years of the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify anticipated years and justify items as necessary for dissemination of results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current & Pending Support — Disclosure and Overlap Avoidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide complete lists of active and pending support for key personnel and describe any scientific or budgetary overlap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If overlap exists, describe how effort and budgets will be adjusted; the application must state there is no scientific or budgetary overlap or show plans to reduce effort (example: reduce active/pending effort so as not to exceed specified calendar months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketches and Complete List of Published Work
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide updated biosketches and a complete list of published work (e.g., MyBibliography link) for investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include publication identifiers (PMCID where available) and ensure biosketches reflect contributions, roles, and relevant publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response to Prior Review (Resubmission) / Introduction to Application
rubrics_metrics.description: For resubmissions, include an Introduction that addresses reviewer comments and describes substantive changes made to the Career Development Plan and Research Strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denote revisions clearly (e.g., vertical black lines) and explicitly respond to reviewer critiques, clarifying coursework, training and other elements requested by reviewers.
